title: Degen Box
tagline: Buy multiple memecoins from multiple chains without bridging through Degen "Box" - indexes consisting of one or more memecoins.

prizes.placement: Build with Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol
prizes.title: Build with Circle's Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol

description:
Degen Box derives from the idea of mutual funds. "Box" on Degen Box acts like an index each representing one or more memecoins from various chains. 

We made Murad's famous memecoin list into a Box, problem is the memecoins live on different chains. Bridging funds is painful, we allow you to buy into boxes, exposing you to those memecoins from your favourite chain (which is Base in our case).
how_its_made:
Degen Box utilizes Base's OCK for easy onboarding, while also allowing our users to on ramp their fiat through Base. Base is also our main entry point hub for people to buy the Boxes.

For multichain interactions, we utilize Circle's CCTP to bridge USDC for our users to other chain so they can gain exposure to those memecoins.

For the Box prices, we utilize Pyth Networks' price feeds to fetch various memecoins prices from multiple chains.
